card.name: Inside drug names after route words
card.fires_on: The first letters or middle pieces of a drug or brand name, mostly right after a route word like intravenous or oral. Also seen in numbers inside percentages and decimals.

modes.description: Opening or middle piece of a drug name following intravenous or oral.

modes.description: Middle pieces of capitalized brand names in label instructions.
